capabilities.title: Immutable competitor package archive
capabilities.delta: Preserve four original uploaded packages and make their feature evidence reproducible.
acceptance: Original SHA-256 and every file member digest match; license/version identity retained.
denial_cases: ZIP replacement, traversal, duplicate or symlink member, oversized expansion.

capabilities.title: Evidence-based comparison and progress
capabilities.delta: Compare capability semantics and usable journeys; track marketed, bundled and runtime states independently.
acceptance: Every row maps archive evidence, MAD4B foundation, task owner and acceptance; no count-based superiority score.
denial_cases: Unverified Pro/marketing promoted to available, docs-only DONE or stale source hash.

capabilities.title: Guided first useful operation
capabilities.delta: Reduce setup friction through connection, safe read/draft, reviewed plan, approved execution and eligible undo.
acceptance: Real browser completes first authorized draft/read with no dead-end status page.
denial_cases: Missing consent/Brand authority shown as ready; permissions increased by onboarding.

capabilities.title: Provider credential and profile discoverability
capabilities.delta: Generalize rc.95 SerpApi/DataForSEO setup to all admitted provider-specific credential and account fields.
acceptance: Every provider has reachable setup, save/readback, explicit test and selected account/profile state; GET sends zero HTTP requests.
denial_cases: Secrets reflected in DOM/audit, paid request on render, arbitrary account endpoint.

capabilities.title: Every admin page, legacy route and external action
capabilities.delta: Audit all registered tabs/controls and explain taxonomy/license/host/consent actions with Arabic RTL accessibility.
acceptance: Every page has operable save, empty/denied/error states and a canonical URL; license changes remain vendor/owner handoffs.
denial_cases: Frontend 404 alias, false save success, stale view, automatic license deactivation or host binary install.

capabilities.title: Receipt-backed Undo workspace
capabilities.delta: Provide understandable reverse preview and eligibility above the existing governed reversal service.
acceptance: Current object/field digests, expiry, actor, exact reversal plan and one-time readback receipt bind the action.
denial_cases: Post-write drift, expired receipt, second consumption, revoked actor, irreversible external effect.

capabilities.title: Exact write readback and recovery uncertainty
capabilities.delta: Unify typed stored/emitted readback and reconciliation before retry across object/provider operations.
acceptance: Partial/dropped fields and possible external effect produce explicit uncertain/reconciling states.
denial_cases: Retry after unknown side effect, fabricated rollback, mismatched expected state.

capabilities.title: NHI/agent permission editor and My Access
capabilities.delta: Expose agent/role/object/risk/transport permissions while reusing existing authority and exact grants.
acceptance: Named identities show effective per-object access and clear disable/revoke outcomes.
denial_cases: Wildcard authority, read/exist writer, deleted/demoted user, alternate NHI authority.

capabilities.title: Agent attribution, scope conflict and lifecycle
capabilities.delta: Explain conflicting scopes/roles and bind requests/audit to the current client and subject.
acceptance: Role/subject/resource drift invalidates next admission and pending commit.
denial_cases: Wrong server, cross-site token, restored revoked identity, last-known-role fallback.

capabilities.title: Granular consent and safe presets
capabilities.delta: Expose read-only and reviewed defaults with explicit selected capability/object/risk scope differences.
acceptance: tools/list and tools/call both revalidate selected scope against current authority.
denial_cases: Generic full access token, stale catalog, hidden scope expansion, mounting discovered writes.

capabilities.title: OAuth and MCP client/session compatibility
capabilities.delta: Test real client initialize/list/call, PKCE/refresh/revocation/session/Origin semantics independently of transport availability.
acceptance: Exact resource/issuer/subject/client/build session receipt supports external acceptance.
denial_cases: Refresh replay, revoked token, Origin mismatch, foreign audience, fabricated external receipt.

capabilities.title: GA4 measurement and property selection
capabilities.delta: Add governed analytics reporting with dimension/metric/property discovery and explicit account selection.
acceptance: Property, attribution window, consent, sampling and freshness appear in every report.
denial_cases: Cross-property data, unsupported dimensions, stale token, hidden sampling.

capabilities.title: Search Console queries and index observations
capabilities.delta: Add clicks/impressions/query/page/site/sitemap/index-observation contracts to Search evidence.
acceptance: Verified site scope and language/market/window provenance survive normalization.
denial_cases: Unverified site, conflicting windows, mixed URL identities, signal-as-publication authority.

capabilities.title: Keyword, backlink, competitor and AI visibility adapters
capabilities.delta: Add Semrush/SE Ranking/Ahrefs breadth without coupling Search core to vendor-specific fields or count targets.
acceptance: Provider-specific quotas/currency/rights and equivalent-comparison limits are explicit; existing SerpApi/DataForSEO are reused.
denial_cases: Unknown paid cost, quota mismatch, mixed currency, unsupported Ahrefs parity, automatic content write.

capabilities.title: Form/schema/configuration provider family
capabilities.delta: Cover CF7/WPForms/Gravity/Fluent/JetFormBuilder with provider-specific native contracts.
acceptance: Form fields/repeaters/required/choices and owned configuration survive plan/readback.
denial_cases: Absent premium runtime, foreign serialization, invalid nested field, unreviewed hook.

capabilities.title: Private submissions, retention and export/delete
capabilities.delta: Separate public form schema from privileged submission/PII operations and irreversible deletion.
acceptance: Object/field-level consent, masked previews, bounded export and deletion review are enforced.
denial_cases: PII leak, private uploads, hidden Flamingo dependence, deletion marked reversible.

capabilities.title: Products, variations, attributes and bounded batch
capabilities.delta: Expand native commerce catalog operations with independent stock/hook/risk contracts.
acceptance: HPOS/applicable runtime and product/variation identity readback; disposable reversible canaries.
denial_cases: Stock race, cross-product variation, duplicate batch, unsupported schema.

capabilities.title: Orders, customers, coupons and reports
capabilities.delta: Split financial/private reads from admitted reversible order fields and customer changes.
acceptance: PII masking, current object authorization and per-field effects classify every operation.
denial_cases: Customer leak, amount/payment change promoted by structural test, notification replay.

capabilities.title: Shipping, taxes, gateways, webhooks and refunds
capabilities.delta: Track high-risk external/financial surfaces separately; unsupported refund/gateway work stays gated.
acceptance: Each effect has explicit risk/authority and honest non-reversible classification; no blanket commerce certification.
denial_cases: Payment/refund auto-promotion, unbounded webhook URL, secret leak, undo claim for money movement.

capabilities.title: Elementor structural operations and templates
capabilities.delta: Extend admitted clone/outline/widget/template operations over existing builder foundations.
acceptance: Fresh element IDs, editor locks, structural diffs and exact rendered readback.
denial_cases: Stale editor, dynamic secret reference, malformed tree, cross-template scope.

capabilities.title: Divi 4/5 format-aware operations
capabilities.delta: Add a second independently certified builder adapter with shortcode/block distinction.
acceptance: Dry-run replace/clone/library operations preserve format and regenerate identities.
denial_cases: Mixed/unsupported format, broken shortcodes, active editor, failed rollback.

capabilities.title: Kadence and Gutenberg/FSE templates/styles
capabilities.delta: Add provider-native block/tree/style/template contracts and site-editor scope boundaries.
acceptance: Nested block structure, template/theme identity and reusable-block references verified.
denial_cases: Unregistered blocks, unintended global style blast radius, theme drift, template takeover.

capabilities.title: Six-provider field-level SEO family
capabilities.delta: Generalize Rank Math/SEO foundation across Yoast/AIOSEO/SEOPress/Slim SEO/The SEO Framework.
acceptance: Provider native APIs and per-field ownership; title/meta/social/schema/robots/canonical readback.
denial_cases: Foreign provider overwrite, absent runtime, incompatible schema, generic post-meta shortcut.

capabilities.title: Rendered head, language and archive verification
capabilities.delta: Unify stored-versus-emitted provenance for posts/terms/archives and language/canonical conflicts.
acceptance: Rendered and stored semantics are compared on exact surface/language/cache generation.
denial_cases: Stale head, wrong language, shadowed source treated authoritative, SEO signal direct mutation.

capabilities.title: Visual timeline and structured diffs
capabilities.delta: Expose bounded object/actor/client/date history rather than requiring audit payload interpretation.
acceptance: Stable paging and per-object authorization reveal meaningful typed before/after differences.
denial_cases: Cross-site/private object read, forged history, history presented as guaranteed undo.

capabilities.title: Redaction, retention and portable evidence
capabilities.delta: Preserve evidence integrity while redacting secret/PII fields and supporting governed exports.
acceptance: No API key/token/private field in diff; retained/exported digest chain stays verifiable.
denial_cases: Secret diff, legal-hold deletion, truncated mandatory identity, exported history creates authority.

capabilities.title: Optional AI Workspace and approval cards
capabilities.delta: Add a user-facing conversational layer that invokes existing governed tools through exact reviewed plans.
acceptance: Conversation ownership, tool arguments/diffs and approvals bind to live subject/revision.
denial_cases: Model request grants access, generic shell/PHP exposure, foreign conversation, automatic publish.

capabilities.title: Governed model routing and usage controls
capabilities.delta: Choose admitted models by capabilities/privacy/residency/cost with bounded fallback.
acceptance: Per-request usage reservation, provider provenance and retry reconciliation.
denial_cases: Silent provider/privacy switch, unpriced generation, budget overspend, retry after uncertain charge.

capabilities.title: Copilot, translation, media and audio/video proposals
capabilities.delta: Track broader AI Engine application claims as optional proposals with independent availability and rights proof.
acceptance: Generated content/assets are previews until approved desired-state publication; paid media evidence is separate.
denial_cases: Advertised Pro becomes bundled-certified, missing media rights, unsafe uploads, automatic voice tool authority.

capabilities.title: Knowledge/PDF ingestion, retrieval and vector stores
capabilities.delta: Add optional RAG above Context Authority with approved sources and tenant/field filtering.
acceptance: Source/chunk lineage, deletion, freshness, embeddings/model generation and grounded citations verified.
denial_cases: Poisoned source instructions, private-source leak, malicious PDF, cross-tenant vector, stale retrieval.

capabilities.title: AI forms and bounded function calling
capabilities.delta: Track Pro application feature separately and govern form input/function output/cost boundaries.
acceptance: Each tool call uses existing authority and every file/PII field is explicitly admitted.
denial_cases: Arbitrary API/function exposure, file/path injection, new authority from form content, hidden paid execution.

capabilities.title: Backup and migration artifacts
capabilities.delta: Add backup inventory/trigger and migration package inspection to existing recovery boundaries.
acceptance: Exact package/root/restore epoch and protected receipt handoff; installer details masked.
denial_cases: Installer credential leak, arbitrary archive path, rollback resurrects authority, automatic restore.

capabilities.title: Cache inspection and bounded purge
capabilities.delta: Extend existing cache capability governance to W3 Total Cache and future providers.
acceptance: Purge plan states targets/blast radius and fresh frontend readback.
denial_cases: Uncertified purge, arbitrary URL, host cache bypass, whole-site purge inferred from narrow grant.

capabilities.title: Security status, lockouts and policy claims
capabilities.delta: Expose safe security diagnostics; independently evaluate DLP/injection/anomaly/reputation claims before adopting controls.
acceptance: Sensitive logs masked; ban/unban and security changes use exact review and self-lockout checks.
denial_cases: Marketing treated behavioral proof, self-lockout, PII security log, arbitrary firewall allow.

capabilities.title: Redirect and link management
capabilities.delta: Add provider-native redirect inventory/diff/apply with language and cache-aware acceptance.
acceptance: No loops/open redirects; exact origin/target/status/bound scope readback.
denial_cases: Loop, open redirect, dangerous scheme, external egress or foreign-language takeover.

capabilities.title: Multilingual taxonomy hierarchy reconciliation
capabilities.delta: Address observed WPML out-of-sync taxonomies through scoped plan/diff rather than a blind sync action.
acceptance: Explicit source-language/parent/translation groups; dry-run counts and exact applied hierarchy readback.
denial_cases: Hierarchy cycles, orphan/cross-language parents, unbound all-taxonomy mutation, license mismatch auto repair.

capabilities.title: Core content/media/menus/users and ACF completeness
capabilities.delta: Map remaining object operations and field ownership without equating generic meta CRUD to native provider parity.
acceptance: Each field/object capability has schema, object permission, native readback and admitted risk.
denial_cases: Role escalation, sensitive user meta, unsafe media URL, foreign ACF field serialization.

capabilities.title: Community and event operations
capabilities.delta: Add optional BuddyPress/Events Calendar adapters after site applicability and privacy admission.
acceptance: Private messages/members remain object-authorized; event timezones and pagination are explicit.
denial_cases: Private thread leak, cross-group access, timezone corruption, absent provider auto-certification.

capabilities.title: Capability-local provider recertification
capabilities.delta: Reuse rc.95 discovery/diff/risk controls and extend per-capability behavioral proof without static patch allowlists.
acceptance: Unknown artifact becomes structural candidate; only eligible canary/readback/rollback evidence can promote matching capability.
denial_cases: Version-only provider-wide disable, read drift blocks unrelated capability, automatic grants/mounts, unknown high-risk promotion.

capabilities.title: External handshake, browser and passive performance acceptance
capabilities.delta: Refresh valid external build-bound receipts and collect bounded performance samples through actual providers.
acceptance: Initialize/tools/list same session/build; real browser routes/actions and at least three comparable frontend samples.
denial_cases: Local status called external proof, stale snapshot, fabricated samples, Google re-consent or host binary install automated.

capabilities.title: Runtime Candidate Graph v2
capabilities.delta: Implement provenance-bound provider/component/capability/operation/schema/precondition/effect/reversal/evidence graph snapshots with immutable generation identities.
acceptance: Discover registered symbols, hooks, REST routes, Abilities, MCP descriptors, CPTs/taxonomies/meta, schemas, cron and admin pages through bounded trusted readers.
Implement unknown-plugin candidate packages and descriptive database/endpoint inventory without invoking unknown code, exposing settings secrets or creating writes.
Implement semantic pre/post graph diff and isolate removed/changed capabilities plus dependent workflows while preserving unrelated compatible reads.
denial_cases: GATE Prove false annotations/GET methods, lazy-loader effects, stale workers, schema disappearance, secret schemas and unknown side effects never gain authority.

capabilities.title: Semantic Classification Engine
capabilities.delta: Implement deterministic evidence features for namespace/action/schema/annotations/capabilities/resources/effects/reversibility and a versioned Policy Proposal contract.
acceptance: Implement confidence, contradictory/missing evidence, provenance and classifier-version traces; confidence and operation names are never safety proof.
Separate runtime-discovered facts from reviewed policy overlay; only admitted zero-effect/non-secret read recipes may auto-classify after actual conformance.
Implement owner review for new write/unknown/high-risk proposals and record scope/risk/authority differences without altering grants or mounts.
denial_cases: GATE Prove confidence-only promotion, unsafe GET, lying read annotations, schema-based privilege inference and risk downgrade fail closed.

capabilities.title: Declarative Adapter Manifest
capabilities.delta: Implement immutable declarative manifest schemas for bindings/input/output/preconditions/effects/readback/rollback and explicit reviewed executor IDs.
acceptance: Implement schema-driven adapters only through already admitted typed executor strategies; discovered symbols/routes cannot become arbitrary invocation targets.
Implement manifest signature/version/capability/artifact/generation validation and static effect/egress/secret/cost checks before interpretation.
Expose manifest preview, supported strategy limits, rejected bindings and exact execution/readback provenance without generating or activating PHP.
denial_cases: GATE Reject arbitrary function/class/route names, eval/shell/PHP, generic HTTP, malicious templates and undeclared external or authority effects.

capabilities.title: Dynamic Operation Synthesis and Workflow Compiler
capabilities.delta: Implement schema-derived candidate Content Experience profiles for newly observed CPTs/taxonomies/meta/media/SEO/language/builder bindings.
acceptance: Compile content/meta/taxonomy/media/SEO/translation/publication primitives into typed dependency DAGs with provider/capability resolution.
Implement plan pinning, exact object and input diffs, effect/permission aggregation, idempotency/fencing and compensation boundaries before approved execution.
Bind compiled workflows to existing WorkflowProvider/ContentJob services; provider replacement produces a new plan and invalidates affected approvals.
denial_cases: GATE Prove arbitrary CPT business hardcode, circular plan, removed provider, privilege aggregation, silent replan and publication without authority are rejected.

capabilities.title: Shadow Certification for Reads
capabilities.delta: Implement bounded dual-read shadow recipes over current certified and candidate paths with candidate results excluded from the user-facing active result.
acceptance: Compare object/field/semantic/error/latency/privacy/cost results using policy-defined sample counts, workload coverage and tolerances.
Require proven non-mutating/non-secret behavior and quota/cost authority before shadow execution; uncertain read effects prohibit sampling.
Issue generation-bound structural/read behavioral receipts and promote only existing eligible read exposure with no new grants/tool mounts.
denial_cases: GATE Reject insufficient/correlated/stale samples, hidden external cost/effect, private-field leakage, mismatched objects and inconsistent candidate results.

capabilities.title: Reversible Canary Engine
capabilities.delta: Implement explicit autonomy L3 canary admission tied to pre-existing Staging authority, approved recipe, exact disposable target and bounded effect/cost.
acceptance: Provision isolated fixtures, capture native pre-state, execute candidate operation once, read exact stored/emitted state and evaluate invariants.
Restore through the certified rollback strategy and prove exact original state including hooks/external effects; always record cleanup/outcome uncertainty.
Issue signed exact capability/artifact/schema/recipe/subject/environment/generation behavioral receipts with expiry and revocation.
denial_cases: GATE Prove stale authority, shared/live targets, financial effects, evidence failure, incomplete restoration and cancellation never auto-promote or blindly retry.

capabilities.title: Versioned Runtime Registry and Certification Packs
capabilities.delta: Implement independently versioned signed immutable packs for policy overlays, manifests, acceptance/rollback recipes, Skills/profiles and provider evidence.
acceptance: Separate PHP engine releases from data policy, certification evidence and Skill/profile revisions with trusted compatible schema interpreters.
Implement exact artifact/capability/schema/site/environment binding, chain/key revocation, expiry, anti-replay/rollback protection and atomic registry activation.
Keep restrictive/equal non-authorizing refresh eligible for automation; risk downgrade, new authority, grants or activation eligibility require governed review.
denial_cases: GATE Reject tampered/unsigned/revoked/expired/foreign packs, incompatible interpreters, stale artifacts, partial install and replay after restore.

capabilities.title: Ownership-aware Three-Way Reconciliation
capabilities.delta: Implement resource/field ownership and lineage over Last Managed, Current Runtime and Desired Policy state with exact revision/CAS contracts.
acceptance: Distinguish managed drift, human-owned edits, provider drift and ambiguous conflict across profiles/bindings/workflows/schemas/SEO/settings/Skills.
Generate bounded repair plans for proven owned non-authorizing fields; preserve/rebase valid human deltas only inside explicit unlocked policy.
Route locked/ambiguous/security-sensitive changes to review; never overwrite human Skills, reset authority, resume observations or unfreeze spend by inference.
denial_cases: GATE Prove missing baseline, concurrent edit, changed owner, human language addition, centrally locked field, secret/authority field and partial apply preserve safety.

capabilities.title: Universal Mutation Journal
capabilities.delta: Implement one human-readable journal projection linking operation/actor/agent/why/objects/pre-state/post-state/provider/capability/authority and reversal evidence.
acceptance: Bind every admitted mutation outcome to current execution, readback, uncertainty and external effects using existing audit/journal services.
Expose Undo eligibility/expiry, preview, visual diff and exact governed compensation without creating a second execution or authority system.
Preserve redaction, tenant/object access, integrity, retention and durable receipt ordering across archive/export/restore.
denial_cases: GATE Prove history-only rollback, forged authority links, truncation, external irreversible effects, failed receipts and stale current state cannot report success.

capabilities.title: Update Acceptance and Safe Remediation Pipeline
capabilities.delta: Capture pre-update artifact/graph/workflows/authority/schema/topology/performance and observe post-update generation without changing update authorization.
acceptance: Classify no drift/read drift/changed reversible write/removed capability/authority or topology change/side channel with explicit isolated outcomes.
Compile exact bounded remediation/test/recertification plans under approved autonomy policy and preserve unrelated capabilities/session safety.
Verify registry/Skills/catalog/current eligible-grant projection and issue Update Acceptance Receipt; release rollback needs a preauthorized exact recovery plan.
denial_cases: GATE Inject partial update, stale worker, lost rollback, changed authority/DB topology, new side channel and uncertain API effect; block/reconcile without retry widening.

capabilities.title: Host Capability Registry
capabilities.delta: Implement versioned host observations for filesystem/process/network sandbox/wp-cli/cron/loopback/memory/disk/PHP extensions/database features.
acceptance: Bind observations to exact host/environment profile and trusted bounded probe provenance with expiry; unknown/missing values stay unknown.
Derive execution eligibility from actual prlimit plus admitted network sandbox capability without host-specific fallback code or binaries installation.
Expose one external host remediation action and a read-only recheck; host authority remains separate from WordPress/Staging write authority.
denial_cases: GATE Reject forged tool availability, stale host profile, unsandboxed execution, generic process probes and automatic host package installation.

capabilities.title: External Provider Framework
capabilities.delta: Implement generic descriptors for credentials/account/scopes/quota/economics/rate/rights/health/capability/effects/reconciliation behind registered pinned adapters.
acceptance: Generate provider setup/account/property/profile screens from reviewed field schemas and reuse encrypted secret handles and explicit account tests.
Implement contract-specific response/error/cost normalization, account-bound budgets, circuit breaking and uncertain-charge reconciliation without arbitrary HTTP.
Support configuration packs for Drive/SERP/analytics/research providers only through available reviewed protocol strategies; novel API behavior requires code review.
denial_cases: GATE Prove new scope requires external consent, missing cost/rights stay blocked, opaque credentials never echo and unknown protocols cannot be generic outbound calls.

capabilities.title: Operator Action Center and Autonomy Evaluation
capabilities.delta: Implement L0–L5 autonomy policy views with exact prerequisites and per-plan states AUTO_REPAIRED, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, EXTERNAL_ACTION_REQUIRED and RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
acceptance: Dispatch only safe non-authorizing already-policy-admitted remediation; require one explicit review/consent/host action for blocked plans.
Expose cause, scope, evidence, next step, user-owned conflict, attempt/readback/rollback history and capability-local blast radius.
Measure verified automation/intervention/MTTR/failure/cost rates on an explicit eligible-workload denominator; 90–95 percent remains an aspiration, not claimed readiness.
denial_cases: GATE Prove manual governance cannot be hidden as success, retry loops are bounded, human authority is not inferred and all reported repaired outcomes have real verification.

capabilities.title: Release Rings and Fleet/Multisite Promotion
capabilities.delta: Extend exact update acceptance into site-local release rings and cohort promotion without copying authority across sites.
acceptance: Implement exact site/cohort/generation release-ring identities with site-local authority; no implicit Production ring.
Implement pilot-ring health thresholds, bounded cohorts, per-site receipts and partial rollback state.
Implement distributed rollout fencing/idempotency so duplicate workers cannot promote or rollback the same site twice.
denial_cases: GATE stale cohort, split brain, cross-site authority bleed, provider mismatch, partial rollback and missing site evidence.

capabilities.title: Automation SLOs, Error Budgets and Kill Switch
capabilities.delta: Bound self-healing with measured SLOs, retry budgets, cooldowns, backpressure and an independent kill switch.
acceptance: Define automation SLOs over explicit eligible workload: repair success, false repair, MTTR, quarantine, rollback failure, intervention and cost.
Implement backpressure, queue isolation and circuit breaking for repeated self-heal failures.
Implement durable kill switch stopping L2-L4 automatic actions while preserving L0-L1 observation and governed manual paths.
denial_cases: GATE flapping drift, metric loss, queue storms, exhausted budgets and kill-switch bypass.

capabilities.title: Supply-chain Provenance and Trust
capabilities.delta: Bind runtime/provider/policy artifacts to source-channel, hash, signer/revocation and dependency provenance without treating provenance as authority.
acceptance: Implement source-channel/hash/signer/revocation/dependency provenance for runtime/provider/policy artifacts.
Implement downgrade, mirror mismatch, dependency substitution and unexpected source detection with capability-local quarantine.
Expose provenance/revocation status in operator/update acceptance views with bounded remediation.
denial_cases: GATE unsigned, revoked, downgraded, foreign or dependency-tampered artifacts; signatures cannot create grants or promotion.

capabilities.title: Registry and Policy Schema Migration
capabilities.delta: Evolve signed policy/manifests/registry schemas using explicit reversible migrations and semantic-diff guards.
acceptance: Implement versioned registry/policy/manifest migration DAGs with compatibility declarations and dry-run semantic diffs.
Support declared mixed-generation worker windows without dropping unknown fields or reinterpreting stale evidence.
Require governed review for migrations that lower risk, change authority semantics or make prior ineligible capability executable.
denial_cases: GATE partial migration, stale workers, unknown fields, downgrade, restored old registries and interrupted cutover.

capabilities.title: Adversarial Compatibility Fuzzing and Chaos Certification
capabilities.delta: Add disposable adversarial schema/behavior/concurrency/fault testing around candidate capabilities before broader certification.
acceptance: Implement deterministic disposable schema/property fuzz cases for boundary, malformed-response, contradictory annotation and hidden-effect conditions.
Implement differential compatibility fuzzing across certified and candidate versions without candidate output entering active responses.
Feed reproducible fuzz findings into policy/canary/quarantine evidence without automatic authority changes.
denial_cases: GATE fuzzing Production/shared objects, paid/irreversible effects, arbitrary code or blind retries.

capabilities.title: Restore and Disaster-Recovery Convergence
capabilities.delta: Treat restore/time-travel as a new operational epoch requiring rediscovery, authority rebinding and external-effect reconciliation before writes resume.
acceptance: Implement restore-epoch detection across DB, files, runtime package, Site Profile and registry generations.
Rebuild current artifact/provider/host graphs and reconcile exact site-local grants/authority before writes return.
Implement external-effect reconciliation for actions not rewound by local restore and issue post-restore acceptance receipt.
denial_cases: GATE cloned origins, clock rollback, stale grants, partial restore, revoked providers and unrewound effects; never replay authority.
